entries.author: ADDENDA
entries.title: Nicephori Gregoræ Allocutio ad Andronicum Palæologum, cum victor rediisset
entries.note: Ordo: 'Appendix — Allocutio ad imp. Andronicum Palæologum III 1067'. Greek head ΛΟΓΟΣ ΠΡΟΣΦΩΝΗΜΑΤΙΚΟΣ at 85739, Latin 85779; header 1067 (OCR '1007'). The Elenchus's last line 'Ex Programmate Academico Lipsiensi ad annum 1865 proposito' is a source note on this item (footnote at 85806), not a separate work.

problems: The Elenchus prints NO columns, so every colStatus is body-only; columns come from the body and the Ordo.
Elenchus cut (211..) was longer than the stated 427-478: continued to line ~498 (Ethica, Lapitha, Index, Addenda).
Not entered (Elenchus omits): 'Monitum in sequentia opuscula' (line 51782, col 663, editorial) and 'Index ad Nicephori Gregoræ Historiæ Byzantinæ libros postremos' (Ordo 1065).

OCR page numbers lag/repeat widely (e.g. 641 repeats; 'N83', '95]'), so Fragmenta (643), Epistolae (647), Prologus (663), Moralis enarratio (667), Ex libro de astronomia (987), Catalogus (1047) rest on the page ladder and are less certain than the rest.
Encomium Gregorii Palamae is a cross-reference to tom. CLI; no column given.
